settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale model of an aircraft in your airline's livery, mounted for display. A premium showcase and corporate gift for airlines, cargo carriers, MROs and aviation partners.
settings.s1_body: We build aircraft models in your exact livery - fuselage, wings, engines and tail finished with your colours, logo and registration. Mounted on a desk stand or cradle, it's a premium display piece and corporate gift for airlines, cargo operators, MROs and aviation partners, and a fitting way to mark a new aircraft or route.
settings.case_body: This aircraft was built as part of an interactive display at an exhibition. It was mounted on a motorised base that made the aircraft move back and forth during the activation.
settings.case_quote: Client loved the aircraft so much that he took away my backup model without telling me.
settings.prov_p: An aircraft is a powerful symbol of a brand. A livery-accurate model puts that symbol on a desk - a showpiece and a gift that means something to everyone in aviation.
